settings.question: How are the lamps made?
settings.answer: Each lamp is individually hand-poured with resin, layered decorative details, and a built-in light source. Small variations are expected and make every piece unique.

settings.question: Do the lamps produce an animated effect like the videos?
settings.answer: The lamp creates a bright blue glow and layered scene depth. Video lighting and camera exposure can make the glow appear more dramatic, so real-life brightness may vary by room.

settings.question: Does it come with a power cord and light?
settings.answer: Yes. The lamp includes the installed light component and a compatible power cord unless your product listing states otherwise.

settings.question: Returns & guarantees
settings.answer: If your lamp arrives damaged, contact us with photos within 7 days of delivery. We will help with a replacement or return based on store policy.
